identity.motif: E-B-G-F-G-E | B-E-F-G-B-A: Thorns' opening rhythm and contour with its second degree flattened (Phrygian), then the 'Black Sun' anthem
identity.relation_to_thorns: Thorns' first two bars return almost verbatim in rhythm, a major third higher in E Phrygian; everything around them is louder and faster.

key: E Phrygian (F natural), with a tritone B-flat and a B7 dominant
mood: Final boss, relentless take: churning sixteenth-note low strings, syncopated taiko, choir chants, the Thorns motif eclipsed in the violins and a brass/choir anthem at full force.
palette: Thorns v02 string ensemble extended for the final boss: low strings in octaves, formant choir, low brass, taiko, timpani and a tolling bell
sections: 1-4: the onslaught begins - churning sixteenths in viola and cello over an E pedal, taiko, brass swells from the depths
5-12: choir chants on the accents; violins hurl the eclipsed Thorns motif
13-20: the Black Sun anthem in low brass and choir over the ostinato (Em-F-G-F | Em-Dm-C-F)
21-28: breakdown - viola alone, whispered choir cluster, glassy harmonics, then a rising Am-Bb-B7 build with timpani roll
29-40: climax - anthem in violins two octaves up, choir fortissimo, brass chorale on the motif, low strings in octaves, full taiko; Am-Bb-B7 pushes higher
41-48: coda - tutti 3+3+2 hits, the motif once more, B7 roll back into the loop
title: Noctyrax, the Last Eclipse (take B: Black Sun Onslaught)
